name: ECE 3243
title: Introduction to Nanotechnology
description: Basic concepts of nanoscience; new physical properties at these scales (~1-100 nm); different approaches to fabricate, image, characterize and manipulate nanostructures and nanodevices; current and potential applications in areas as diverse as electronics, health and energy; societal impacts of nanotechnology.
requirement_description: Open only to students in the School of Engineering.
